questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the questions.

A quadratic equation has the standard form ax² + bx + c = 0, with a ≠ 0.

(i) Identify a, b, c for the equation 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0.
(ii) Solve it by factorisation.
(iii) Verify both roots satisfy the equation.
(iv) State the relationship between the roots and the coefficients.

Read the passage and answer the questions.

The quadratic formula gives x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac))/(2a). The discriminant D = b² − 4ac tells us about the nature of roots.

(i) Solve x² − 6x + 8 = 0 using the quadratic formula.
(ii) Compute D and state the nature of roots.
(iii) For x² − 4x + 4 = 0, find D and the roots.
(iv) For x² + 2x + 5 = 0, find D and the nature of roots.
questions.answer:
(i) a = 1, b = −6, c = 8. x = (6 ± √(36 − 32))/2 = (6 ± 2)/2. Roots: 4, 2.
(ii) D = 36 − 32 = 4 > 0. Two distinct REAL roots.
(iii) D = 16 − 16 = 0. Repeated (double) root: x = 4/2 = 2.
(iv) D = 4 − 20 = −16 < 0. No real roots (two complex conjugate roots). Real solutions don't exist in R.

(i) Complete the square on the left side.
(ii) Solve the resulting equation.
(iii) Verify by substitution.
(iv) Apply completing the square to x² − 4x − 12 = 0.

Read the passage and answer the questions.

A park is rectangular with length 5 m more than its breadth. Its area is 84 m².

(i) Let breadth = x m. Express the length.
(ii) Form a quadratic equation in x.
(iii) Solve for x.
(iv) State the dimensions of the park.
questions.answer:
(i) Length = x + 5 m.
(ii) Area = length × breadth: x(x + 5) = 84 ⇒ x² + 5x − 84 = 0.
(iii) x² + 5x − 84 = 0. Discriminant = 25 + 336 = 361 = 19². x = (−5 ± 19)/2 ⇒ x = 7 or x = −12. Reject negative (breadth must be positive). So x = 7.
(iv) Breadth = 7 m, length = 12 m. (Verify: 7 × 12 = 84 ✓.)

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the questions.

The product of two consecutive positive integers is 132.

(i) Let the smaller integer be x. Express the other.
(ii) Form a quadratic equation.
(iii) Solve for x.
(iv) State both integers.
questions.answer:
(i) Other = x + 1.
(ii) x(x + 1) = 132 ⇒ x² + x − 132 = 0.
(iii) x = (−1 ± √(1 + 528))/2 = (−1 ± √529)/2 = (−1 ± 23)/2 ⇒ x = 11 or x = −12. Take positive: x = 11.
(iv) Two consecutive positive integers: 11 and 12. (Verify: 11 × 12 = 132 ✓.)

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the questions.

The sum of a number and its reciprocal is 26/5.

(i) Let the number be x. Set up an equation.
(ii) Clear fractions to get a quadratic.
(iii) Solve the quadratic.
(iv) State the number(s).
questions.answer:
(i) x + 1/x = 26/5.
(ii) Multiply by 5x: 5x² + 5 = 26x ⇒ 5x² − 26x + 5 = 0.
(iii) D = 676 − 100 = 576 = 24². x = (26 ± 24)/10 ⇒ x = 5 or x = 1/5.
(iv) Two numbers: 5 and 1/5. Note that each is the reciprocal of the other — symmetric solution.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the questions.

Given the quadratic kx² − 4x + 1 = 0, find values of k for which the equation has real and equal roots.

(i) Write the discriminant in terms of k.
(ii) For real and equal roots, set the discriminant condition.
(iii) Solve for k.
(iv) Verify by computing the (repeated) root for that k.
questions.answer:
(i) D = (−4)² − 4·k·1 = 16 − 4k.
(ii) Real and equal roots ⇔ D = 0 ⇒ 16 − 4k = 0.
(iii) k = 4.
(iv) With k = 4: 4x² − 4x + 1 = 0 ⇒ (2x − 1)² = 0 ⇒ x = 1/2 (repeated). Repeated root confirmed.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the questions.

A train travels 360 km at a uniform speed. If the speed were 5 km/h faster, the journey would take 1 hour less.

(i) Let the original speed = x km/h. Write expressions for original time and faster-train time.
(ii) Form an equation using 'faster time = original − 1'.
(iii) Simplify into a quadratic.
(iv) Solve for x.
questions.answer:
(i) Original time = 360/x hours. Faster time = 360/(x + 5) hours.
(ii) 360/(x + 5) = 360/x − 1.
(iii) Multiply by x(x + 5): 360x = 360(x + 5) − x(x + 5) ⇒ 360x = 360x + 1800 − x² − 5x ⇒ x² + 5x − 1800 = 0.
(iv) D = 25 + 7200 = 7225 = 85². x = (−5 + 85)/2 = 40 (taking positive). Original speed = 40 km/h. (Faster = 45 km/h; check: 360/40 = 9 h, 360/45 = 8 h, difference = 1 ✓.)

Read the passage and answer the questions.

A right triangle has its hypotenuse 1 cm more than its longer leg, and its shorter leg is 7 cm less than the longer leg.

(i) Let the longer leg = x cm. Express the hypotenuse and shorter leg.
(ii) Use the Pythagorean theorem to set up an equation.
(iii) Simplify into a quadratic.
(iv) Solve for x and state all three sides.
questions.answer:
(i) Hypotenuse = (x + 1) cm; shorter leg = (x − 7) cm.
(ii) (x − 7)² + x² = (x + 1)².
(iii) Expand: x² − 14x + 49 + x² = x² + 2x + 1 ⇒ x² − 16x + 48 = 0.
(iv) D = 256 − 192 = 64. x = (16 ± 8)/2 ⇒ x = 12 or x = 4. With x = 4, shorter leg = −3 (impossible). So x = 12. Sides: shorter leg = 5, longer leg = 12, hypotenuse = 13. (Verify: 25 + 144 = 169 ✓ — a 5-12-13 triangle.)
